status: post hoc: added after the prespecified outputs were seen; not part of the prespecified judgments
state_diff: max absolute difference over all six state components (u, v and four derivatives) and all training quadrature points, raw-storage run minus projected-storage rerun
mode3: mass MAC and amplitude ratio between the trained mode-3 states, each after its own policy's projection
defect: normalized non-orthogonality of the projected stored set [phi1, P(phi2)] before mode 3; the jitter column is the share left by the absolute 1e-14 Gram jitter of the exact path
